items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 75:1
items.html: The aspect of the MEM of Tzelem that was corrected in the first three of the Mochin, delimiting them all around as with a ring so that they do not receive Hochma, is called a ring, as in Answer 74 above. And because of this correction in the Mochin of Arich Anpin, in which the Galgalta of Arich Anpin was corrected in the MEM of Tzelem, the Mochin of Aba and Ima of Nekudim were concealed in them, for they no longer have any possibility of being revealed in the world of Atzilut, since Aba and Ima of Nekudim used to receive Hochma even to the aspect of the first three of their Mochin, for there this correction of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK did not yet exist. And on account of this concealment, the Mochin of Arich Anpin are called by the name ring. And the concealment of Aba, which is in the Galgalta of Arich Anpin, is called the pure ring; and the concealment of Ima, which is in the Sealed Brain of Arich Anpin, is called the great ring. (Page 324, Items 66 and 68).
